verdict.rationale: ADP's API Central lets developers create integration projects with security certificates, assign specific APIs to each project (via templates and API discovery), and use OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect so only authorized systems can access data. Per-project API assignment is a form of credential scoping. However, it is a separately purchased add-on, its availability for RUN specifically is not stated, and nothing describes agent-oriented or fine-grained least-privilege credential issuance. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that API Central works with RUN, documented least-privilege scopes or permission granularity per credential, agent-specific credential guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
